children: SafeSpace Global announced two financing agreements with Crom to strengthen liquidity and funding flexibility. The company set up a discretionary equity line of credit of up to $10 million, enabling periodic common stock sales over 36 months subject to a 4.99% ownership cap and a resale registration on Form S-1 within 30 business days. Separately, SafeSpace issued a senior secured convertible note with up to $1.1 million in principal (up to $1.0 million in gross proceeds), funded in two tranches, bearing 10% interest and a $100,000 original issue discount, with 12-month maturities from each tranche funding and defined conversion features. The note is secured by a lien on company and subsidiary assets; default terms include 15% interest and a 125% redemption right.
Agreement 1: SafeSpace Global Establishes $10 Million Equity Line of Credit With Crom
: Equity purchase agreement (ELOC) for up to $10 million of common stock and registration rights
Agreement 2: SafeSpace Global Issues Up to $1.1 Million Senior Secured Convertible Note to Crom
: Senior secured convertible promissory note and securities purchase agreement
: 12 months from each tranche funding date
: Raise working capital with flexible conversion terms
